units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 21:18">Targ. Job XXI, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:3">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו גנו בי ת׳</he> (not <he>הוה גני</he>) (R. Akiba and his wife) slept on straw.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הבו לי פורתא דת׳ וכ׳</he> give me some straw, for my wife has given birth &c.
